sheets.name: Transform
notes: Write the label, your name and the date on the plate.
You will use **one 100 µL tube of competent cells** for the whole experiment.
Per transformation: **16 µL cells + KCM and 0.5 µL miniprep**.
Be gentle mixing the cells or you will kill them.
**Never let the cells warm up.** They do not leave the cold block until the heat shock.

sheets.name: Assay
notes: Paste the raw fluorescence and OD600 into the analysis sheet, then check the CV before trusting anything — a coefficient of variation much above 50 means the replicates disagree and the averages are meaningless.
RPU is fluorescence per OD unit, normalised to pJ01.

howto: One row per person. Everyone in the group adds their own experiment number and the clones they are taking on — type a clone and press Enter, or paste a whole list. The controls below are shared across the group, so they are measured once, not once each. All three are on to start with; switch off any you are not running. The counts update as you go and tell you how many plates and blocks the group needs.
